body.x: Nikon (www.nikon.com), specializing in optics and imaging products, announced the release of the D5500, a Nikon DX-format digital SLR camera at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Being the world's smallest, lightest, and slimmest digital SLR camera, the D5500 features a touch screen vari-angle LCD monitor and built-in Wi-Fi function, first for a Nikon digital SLR camera to be equipped with.The D5500 has a pixel count of 24.2-million, a Nikon DX-format CMOS sensor, and the EXPEED 4 image-processing engine. Built with carbon-fiber composite material and a completely new layout for the internal structure made this model small and light, yet durable. It has ISO 100 to 25600, and has many special effects modes to create different look to the pictures.
